Standard: Fuel carrying systems (e.g., components, manifolds, lines, and fittings) are fire resistant for at least 5 minutes at a minimum flame temperature of 2000 °F. Lubrication carrying systems and hydraulic fluid carrying systems (e.g., components, manifolds, lines, and fittings) are fireproof for at least 15 minutes at a minimum flame temperature of 2000 °F. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review documentation (e.g., hardware drawings, system configuration descriptions, materials and manufacturing records, design data records, inspection reports, videos, or other substantiating records and reports) and verify fire resistance or fireproof capability of the hardware. Analysis.
  (1) Analysis is conducted to verify the flammable fluid systems are fire resistant or fireproof. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Fire testing verifies that all fuel components, fuel lines, oil carrying components, and oil lines are fire resistant or fireproof, respectively.
